# judo-meta-jql

> JQL (JUDO Query Language) metamodel — an Xtext-based DSL that defines the grammar, parser, and AST for declarative queries in the JUDO platform.

Key facts:
- Java 21, Maven 3.9.4 with Tycho 4.0.13 (Eclipse plugin packaging)
- Multi-module project with 8 submodules across 3 layers: core DSL, OSGi integration, and Eclipse IDE
- Built on Xtext 2.39.0, Eclipse EMF, ANTLR 3.2.0, and Google Guice
- Part of the [judo-community](https://github.com/BlackBeltTechnology/judo-community) ecosystem
- License: Eclipse Public License 2.0 (EPL-2.0)

## Docs

- [README.md](README.md): Project overview, architecture diagrams, JQL expression syntax, and API examples
- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): Developer guide with build commands, module descriptions, and coding conventions
- [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md): Development setup, project structure, and troubleshooting
- [.github/CIFLOW.md](.github/CIFLOW.md): Branching strategy, version numbering, and CI/CD pipeline diagrams

## Modules — Core DSL

- [model/pom.xml](model/pom.xml): Xtext grammar, EMF Ecore model, generated parser, and JqlParser runtime API
- [model-test/pom.xml](model-test/pom.xml): JUnit 5 tests for parser, grammar validation, and model loading

## Modules — OSGi Integration

- [osgi/pom.xml](osgi/pom.xml): OSGi bundle repackaging with JqlDslModelBundleTracker for runtime model discovery
- [osgi-itest/pom.xml](osgi-itest/pom.xml): Pax Exam integration tests verifying bundle loading in Apache Karaf

## Modules — Eclipse IDE

- [ide/ide-common/pom.xml](ide/ide-common/pom.xml): Language Server Protocol initialization via Guice
- [ide/ui/pom.xml](ide/ui/pom.xml): Eclipse editor with content assist, outline view, labels, and quick fixes
- [ide/feature/feature.xml](ide/feature/feature.xml): Eclipse IDE feature packaging

## Modules — Distribution

- [feature/feature.xml](feature/feature.xml): Eclipse feature descriptor for plugin installation
- [site/pom.xml](site/pom.xml): P2 update site for Eclipse installation

## Depends on

- [osgi-utils](../../runtime/osgi-utils): OSGi utility library — lifecycle tracking, config monitoring, ranked services

## Used by

- [judo-jql-ide-eclipse](../../eclipse/judo-jql-ide-eclipse): Eclipse plugin for JQL editing with content assist and validation
- [judo-meta-expression](../judo-meta-expression): Expression metamodel — type-safe numeric, string, temporal, and collection expressions
- [judo-meta-expression-asm](../judo-meta-expression-asm): Bridges Expression metamodel with ASM for symbolic reference resolution
- [judo-meta-expression-esm](../judo-meta-expression-esm): Bridges Expression metamodel with ESM for expression evaluation and validation
- [judo-meta-expression-psm](../judo-meta-expression-psm): Bridges Expression metamodel with PSM for type resolution and measurement support
- [judo-meta-jcl](../judo-meta-jcl): JCL metamodel — typed expression and statement DSL extending JQL
- [judo-meta-script](../judo-meta-script): Script metamodel — typed scripting language with ASM/ESM adapters
- [judo-platform](../../runtime/judo-platform): Model-driven OSGi runtime platform with REST APIs and Karaf deployment
- [judo-services](../../runtime/judo-services): OSGi runtime services enabling multiple data models in a single Karaf container
- [judo-tatami](../../runtime/judo-tatami): Model transformation pipeline — ESM/PSM to deployable application artifacts
- [judo-tatami-base](../../runtime/judo-tatami-base): PSM transformation pipeline — models to schemas, expressions, and configurations
- [judo-tatami-jsl](../../runtime/judo-tatami-jsl): JSL-to-runtime model transformation engine (PSM, ASM, UI, RDBMS, etc.)

## Optional

- [docs/pom.xml](docs/pom.xml): AsciiDoc documentation and PlantUML diagrams
- [.github/workflows/build.yml](.github/workflows/build.yml): CI/CD build pipeline
- [LICENSE.txt](LICENSE.txt): Eclipse Public License 2.0 text
